name: Unidentified world
description: During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the Bimm expeditor Crote operated from a planet somewhere in the galaxy. In 3 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Hoth, the bounty hunter Nariss Siv Loqesh traveled to the world to have Crote hold the Bothan Bie Breil'lya captive on his behalf.
lead_paragraphs: During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the Bimm expeditor Crote operated from a planet somewhere in the galaxy. In 3 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Hoth, the bounty hunter Nariss Siv Loqesh traveled to the world to have Crote hold the Bothan Bie Breil'lya captive on his behalf.
